Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring verification of employment eligibility by the state and its political subdivisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring verification of employment eligibilityby the state and its political subdivisions; and adding a new sectionto chapter 41.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that the federal immigration andnationality act makes it unlawful to hire for employment an alienknowing the alien is an unauthorized alien with respect to suchemployment. The legislature therefore intends to require the state andall counties, cities, towns, and other political subdivisions thereofto verify the employment eligibility of individuals hired foremployment. (2) In accordance with the federal immigration and nationality act,the state and all counties, cities, towns, and other politicalsubdivisions thereof shall complete an employment eligibilityverification form for each individual hired for employment. The stateand all counties, cities, towns, and other political subdivisions p. 1 HB 1264thereof shall also use the e-verify program administered by the UnitedStates citizenship and immigration services to confirm eachindividual's employment eligibility. (3) For the purpose of this section, "unauthorized alien" means thesame as in section 274A of the immigration and nationality act (8U.S.C. Sec. 1324a).
